name: Luminárias (Brazil)
description: White field with a green border, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Luminárias is a municipality in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 30 November 1972 (the coat of arms and flag were adopted by Law No. 346 of 30 November 1972, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a star over hills, reading LUMINÁRIAS 27-12 1948
